entry.description: Conditional exact-rank five, six and seven elliptic-curve constructions. The analytic theorem itself is not formalized. Direct AI connection: The metadata attributes Lean proof construction and checks to GPT6 Codex. Public manuscript identity/priority is not established by the private upload digest; distinguish source prose supervision from review of this Lean project. No downloaded proof artifact was executed. entry.description: Distinguishing planar Brownian images of time sets and measures. The primary source reports: Troscheit reports mutual singularity of planar Brownian image laws for s-Frostman probability time measures on [0,1], with 0<s<1, when their normalized expected correlation profiles have a nonvanishing limsup difference, including the stated lattice versus non-lattice self-similar class under the open set condition and dimension restrictions. In a fixed-dimension two-contraction family, each parameter has finitely many possible exceptions, and sufficiently small dimensions give pairwise separation. Minkowski-neighborhood reconstruction transfers specified measure-law distinctions to compact image sets. Equal profiles need not identify the original measure. Direct AI connection: The primary paper says LLMs performed part of the two-contraction calculations and drafted much Lean code; the arguments and ideas are human-created, with some influence from formalization. Owner metadata names Claude and GPT6. Further checking: Establish which calculations and proof changes were AI contributions; audit profile asymptotics, mutual-singularity quantifiers, small-dimension restrictions and Minkowski reconstruction. The formalization proves renewal results only for the self-similar laws used, not the full cited renewal theorem. Author checks are not independent review. No downloaded proof artifact was executed. Preserve provisional=1, low strict confidence, unreviewed and no strict Superhuman override. The general profile-separation theorem explicitly requires a common Frostman exponent 0<s<1; no unrestricted all-dimension or arbitrary-measure reconstruction claim is made.

entry.description: Further spherical Ramsey constructions and classification corollaries. entry.description: New reversible quantum-circuit architectures and resource improvements. The primary source reports: Gu, Kemeny, Yelin and Lukin report seven coherent computational-primitive circuit designs improving both Toffoli and peak-qubit counts over their cited baselines, and a new branch-decoding architecture that makes prime-field divsteps inversion practical without retaining a full branch-history stack. The point-addition designs expand the stated qubit/Toffoli trade-off; other tasks use their specified precision and failure budgets. These are constructions and branch-recovery mathematics, not a proof of global resource optimality. Direct AI connection: The paper describes evaluator-guided LLM circuit development; the dated Anthropic primary announcement names Claude Mythos5 and attributes new algebraic branch-decoding identities and largely autonomous circuit design, with human task specifications and review. Further checking: Audit the exact branch-decoding theorem and coherent phase/uncomputation correctness, rare-input failure budgets, circuit/resource accounting and comparisons. An independent evaluator is not an independent specialist audit; benchmark scores alone are not the inclusion basis. Do not transfer a selected17x gate comparison or12x decoding gain to every task or promise a practical quantum advantage. No downloaded proof artifact was executed. Preserve provisional=1, low strict confidence, unreviewed and no strict Superhuman override.
